'''Vitor Alves Da Silva Ralltiir Uprising''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Vitor Alves Da Silva]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls53.htm Ralltiir Uprising], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010119095000/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls53.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
